blockers.title: The claimed DR-103 leftover partition silently drops accepted schemas.v11 open decision OD-2
evidence: The subject bases its measurement on component-manifest-schemas.v11 at the correct 1c0b8868... digest and D-104, and then says the six listed leftover-design obligations remain.

schemas.v11 /namedOpenDecisions contains OD-2 with standing 'OPEN. Still not folded at v11', candidate owner 'this schema surface (DR-103)', and a consequence that activation is work for a later successor of this artifact.
schemas.v11 /namedOpenDecisions/OD-2/registerEchoAtApplication requires the live DR-103 row to name OD-2 alongside OD-1 on any later application/MF-6.

The subject accounts for OD-1 but contains no OD-2 obligation, no OD-2 summary member, no OD-2 later-work route, and no OD-2 application echo. D-104 recorded v11 as DR-103's accepted schema successor and did not dispose this open decision.
blockers.impact: The artifact's central split is not source-complete. Sealing it would preserve a false six-leftover inventory and set up a later MF-6 to omit an explicit accepted-schema register-echo obligation. That can hide unresolved DR-103 design work while the artifact is being used to decide whether only execution remains.
blockers.requiredRepair: Account for OD-2 explicitly without deciding it: add it to the obligation partition with its OPEN DR-103 standing, update the leftover count and summary, preserve its later-successor activation, and carry its required register echo into any proposed later MF-6. Alternatively, provide a source-grounded disposition that lawfully removes it from DR-103; omission is not a disposition. Do not edit file 08 in this candidate.

shouldFix.title: V2-A1 is classified as future leftover even though the accepted v11 schema already records and implements its repair
evidence: The subject marks OBL-V2-A1 leftoverDesign true, says a later schemas successor may land V2-A1, and says the file-08 cell is stale only on fixture absence.
schemas.v11 /repairLog has finding V2-A1 with disposition REPAIRED and names the additions and amendments implementing it.

schemas.v11 /indexSchema/collisionUniverse contains the defining different-stableId collision-universe sentence and explicitly identifies it as the V2-A1 repair; the accepted index key is (stableId, version, scope).
D-104 recorded these exact v11 bytes as DR-103's accepted schema successor. The fact that fixture-corpus.v6 does not carry schema prose does not make an already-landed schema repair leftover.
shouldFix.impact: The conservative error does not close unresolved work, but it makes the measurement and later-work route false and understates the stale content in the live DR-103 status cell.
shouldFix.requiredRepair: Reclassify V2-A1 as specified/repaired-not-leftover under schemas.v11 and D-104, remove the proposal for a future schema successor to land it, and state that a later separately reviewed MF-6 would reconcile the live row's historical V2-A1 and fixture-absence prose without applying that MF-6 here.

summary: REJECT at 1 blocker and 1 SHOULD-FIX. The candidate correctly preserves D-013's SATISFIED-refusal, verifies rather than executes the 51 authored fixtures, keeps the G15 specification unauthored, preserves the exact live G15 owner, and avoids deciding OD-1, scoring Unicode, producing a lock, retargeting TC-SIG ceremony, changing required-now, or authorizing implementation. It is nevertheless not a faithful leftover join: accepted schemas.v11 explicitly carries OPEN DR-103 decision OD-2, which the candidate omits entirely, while the candidate sends V2-A1 to a future schema even though schemas.v11 records that finding as REPAIRED and contains its defining law.
